reason: Three-step construction: the bounded case via the L-infinity pairing lemma and extension by density; the general case via componentwise range truncation, Banach-Alaoglu under the ultrafilter lemma, and uniqueness on the dense atomic span; linearity and annihilation of constants. Examined every dependency, including that thm-banach-alaoglu assumes the ultrafilter lemma and does not require completeness.
